limitations: measurement class 2 (fake quantization, CPU float execution): not packed storage and not a kernel-backed measurement; no latency is claimed
one model only (the pre-registered unit is the model; with n_models = 1 the model-cluster bootstrap is degenerate and a cell-level bootstrap is reported beside it)

`layer_output` damage is the layer's own output error on one calibration batch (the frozen proxy unit); `model_output` damage is the end-to-end change of the final hidden state when that layer alone is compressed (the Tier-0 fixture's target)
`per_layer_output_error` is the exact plug-in estimator of the `layer_output` damage and is therefore tautological (rho = 1) on that target; it is a sanity anchor, not a competitor

proxies whose context (following normalisation, measured residual error, estimated downstream gain) is absent fall back to their documented context-free form; the per-cell `fallback_fraction` records it

the variant grid is a small predeclared subset of the frozen grid (ranks {8, 16, 32}, bits {2, 4, 8}); the rank-dominant cells use 8-bit factors, the near-lossless setting of the frozen grid, so the truncation dominates their damage
